paragraphs: Anonymous Alerts sells a reporting platform that gives students, staff and community members a way to raise concerns before they turn into serious incidents. It is used by K-12 schools, districts, colleges and public safety organizations nationwide.

Students can anonymously report bullying, behavioral concerns, threats of violence or mental health risks through a mobile or web interface designed for use across age groups. Designated school administrators receive the information immediately. From a centralized dashboard they can review, manage and investigate reports. Staff can hold real-time conversations with tip submitters while the submitter keeps anonymity. Reporting categories, workflows, notification settings and response protocols can be configured for each organization. A companion panic escalation app lets staff instantly alert administrators and safety personnel.

The company says the system helps schools comply with state laws requiring anonymous reporting systems for school safety and violence prevention. A dedicated page covers Alyssas Law compliance in New York. Newtown Public School District is named on the site as one district that chose the reporting app. The company lists United States patents on the technology, with additional US and non-US patents pending. Anonymous 2-way Communications is registered with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

quote.text: Give students, staff, and community members a safe way to report concerns before they turn into serious incidents.
